facts.rationale: Corrects the unconditional once-only cache claim by preserving the zero-sentinel exceptional branch, and identifies the delegated termination operation from canonical helper code.
facts.value: Every call applies the progression-derived uniform model scale. Hitbox updates occur only when hitbox 0 is enabled. If xDD8 equals zero, the callback copies the hitbox's current scale into xDD8, then sets hitbox scale to xDD8 multiplied by model scale. A nonzero cached base is reused, avoiding repeated multiplication of the already-scaled hitbox value; if the captured base is zero, the cache remains zero and later enabled-hitbox calls can capture again. The callback finally decrements the item's lifetime through it_80273130 and returns whether the resulting timer is at most zero.

facts.rationale: Corrects sound to controller rumble using the full canonical helper chain; preserves the existing lifecycle summary while distinguishing the computed damage input from owner-adjusted stored damage.
facts.value: The constructor copies parent/source references, position, facing and explosion progression into spawn and item state. Initialization uses normalized progression to select owner-controller rumble and camera-quake tiers, while animation uses progression and article attributes to compute model scale, the enabled hitbox's damage input and its cached-base-scaled size. The damage helper accepts a u32 input and may further adjust stored damage using owner state. Destruction clears ownership, removes article-parented effects and resets xDE0.
